overview.title: AI practice
overview.description: Practise real visitor conversations by text or voice, then see your score with evidence from what you said. Practice is formative: trainer marks and programme rules decide certification.
overview.descriptionNoCertificate: Practise real visitor conversations by text or voice, then see your score with evidence from what you said. Practice is formative.
overview.howBody1: Each conversation is scored on five criteria from 0 to 4: empathy and professionalism, discovery questions, clarity, accuracy and boundaries, and solution and follow-through. The total out of 20 becomes a score out of 100.
overview.howBody2: Every criterion quotes what you said and gives one thing to try next. Accent, voice and background are never scored.
